question: What Are the Main Modbus Function Codes?
body_html:
Modbus function codes are one byte numbers in every request that tell the slave which action to perform. The same codes work on Modbus RTU and Modbus TCP.

CodeAction
01Read coils (up to 2000 bits)
02Read discrete inputs
03Read holding registers (up to 125)
04Read input registers
05 / 06Write single coil / single register
15 / 16Write multiple coils / registers

An exception reply returns the function code plus 0x80.
